about.description: FX perpetual on Gains Network tracking New Zealand Dollar (NZD) versus the US dollar, with pricing referencing Chainlink DON FX feeds. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC / DAI / WETH on Arbitrum / Polygon / Base, giving users synthetic exposure to New Zealand Dollar/USD price movement without holding either currency as cash.
